breakdown: 动(move)+作(do) — a movement you make

examples.py: Qǐng gēn zhe wǒ zuò dòngzuò.
Dòngzuò tài dà huì dǎrǎo biéren.

breakdown: 发(send out)+生(arise) — something arising

Wǒ bù xīwàng zhè zhǒng shì fāshēng.
examples.en: I hope this kind of thing doesn't happen.
A traffic jam occurred on the road.

examples.en: The company needs a new direction of development.
He is building his career here.

khmer: វិធីសាស្ត្រ

examples.py: Zhè shì yí ge hǎo fāngfǎ.

examples.en: We need to find a new method.

examples.py: Yòng zhèngquè de fāngfǎ cái néng chénggōng.

examples.en: I don't understand this aspect well.

examples.en: There is little material on this aspect.

examples.en: His life direction is very clear.
